sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live LIS subdomain identifies LIS as the authority administering the Visa on Arrival system. It expressly makes use conditional on whether a Liberian embassy exists in the traveller’s country, so it is not a nationality-wide passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The same current LIS service establishes that its pretravel PDF/QR step concludes with an immigration officer issuing a physical sticker at Roberts International Airport; it is not eVisa issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once completed, you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.

sources.title: Service Delivery Charter
sources.officialityEvidence: The live LIS Charter identifies an applicant-host letter, passport bio-data copy, seven-working-day processing and an unstated eligibility test for VOA. It does not list eligible ordinary-passport nationalities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens from Countries who meet the eligibility criteria to enter Liberia.

sources.title: Launch of Liberia’s Visa on Arrival and Re-entry Permit Issuing System
sources.officialityEvidence: The live LIS announcement identifies the March 2025 launch as Visa on Arrival and Re-entry Permit issuance, not a published eVisa nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: officially launched the new Visa on Arrival and Re-entry Permit Issuing System

sources.title: Discover Liberia: Entry and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live LNTA page gives a non-exhaustive “most visitors” statement and directs travellers to confirm with the embassy or airline; it cannot support a nationality complement or replace LIS issuance conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Requirements change — always confirm with the Liberian embassy or your airline close to your travel date.
